name: Adriana Franco
office: South Whittier School District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 5

items.text: Adriana Franco is a candidate for the South Whittier School District Governing Board, Trustee Area No. 5. She serves as an alternate voting member of the Community Advisory Committee for the Whittier Area Cooperative Special Education Program, representing the district.
